thread:
elaine: follow-up from the postmortem  hosted-tier p99 burned ~40% of weekly error budget during the spike. need short-term SLO edits + clear owners for remediation. thoughts?
mike: i'll own dashboard updates and synthetic probes. adding a 'kv-cache-miss' tag to incident panels. ETA 4/2.
devon: root cause looks like combined long-prompts + small batch sizes causing KV cache thrash on quantized models. propose temporary p99 rebaseline 210ms -> 270ms for 10 days while fixes roll. will include rollback gates.
elaine: @devon please add measurement queries and rollback criteria to the action item ticket. we need product-friendly wording for the SLO page.
mike: sample prometheus query i'll use for the p99 panel: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) * 1000
alert-bot: alert created: hosted-p99-errorbudget-burn > 10%/week -> notify #eng-oncall
ops-bot: postmortem 2026-03-29-2468 follow-ups created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2468
devon: remediation list: (1) prefix-cache aggressive mode for quantized variants (owner: devon, ETA: 4/3), (2) batching window heuristics for mixed prompt lengths (owner: mike, ETA: 4/4), (3) lightweight native guard for quantized allocator edge-case (owner: infra-oncall, ETA: 4/2).
elaine: rollback gates: sustained p99 <= 220ms for 48h in canary, error-budget burn <5%/week for 1 week, synthetic probe stable for 72h. owners: canary->mike, budget->elaine, probe->mike.
mike: added saved filter 'kv-cache-miss-signature' to dashboard and an annotation for the incident. creating PR for dashboards now.
devon: timeline ok. i'll draft the SLO rollback proposal by 4/1 COB and attach to ticket. reconvene 4/4 after canary.
elaine: thanks. i'll update the postmortem with owners + acceptance criteria and ping here when done. :white_check_mark:
